verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack shows Teams supporting scheduled or recurring jobs/workflows (e.g., no mention of Power Automate/Workflows integration, cron-like triggers, or recurring automation setup) — the docs cover bots, tabs, message extensions, webhooks, and CLI tooling but nothing about recurring/scheduled automation. Missing for 10: any documentation of recurring/scheduled workflow triggers, workflow automation platform integration, or CLI/API support for scheduling jobs.
